title: Pan-Seared Fish in Papillote
description: A simple and flavorful dish where fish is cooked in parchment paper with a touch of Croatian spices. Perfect for a quick and healthy meal.

ingredients.name: Papillote parchment paper
ingredients.notes: Large enough to wrap the fish

ingredients.name: Croatian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available in most Croatian or Mediterranean stores

instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Place a piece of fish in the center of a large piece of parchment paper.
Add a sprinkle of Croatian spice blend, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a drizzle of olive oil over the fish.
Top with a minced garlic clove.
Fold the parchment paper to create a packet, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the packets on a baking sheet and bake for 8-10 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
